senses.gloss: f. pl. (prob. contr. of איבעיר׳; בער), א׳ דזהרא lamp-lighters, hand-maids who attended to the lights.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:1:3">Y. Yoma III, beg. 40ᵇ</cite>; Y. R. Hash. II, beg. 57ᵈ R. … handled things forbidden to handle on the Sabbath <he>על פום א׳ דז׳</he> (Y. R. Hash. l. c., insert <cite ref="Q00246"><he>פום</he></cite>) on the lamplighters’ declaring that night had set in <he>(חשיכה מוצאי שבת</he>). [The context proves that our w. designates a person or persons.]
